summary: Security platform that detects exposed secrets and credentials in source code, with a lasting free Starter plan for small teams.

pricing.details: Starter 0 €, Always, no credit card — up to 25 developers, unlimited real-time scanning, up to 500 historical scan detections, 10,000 API calls/month, Internal Secrets Monitoring. Business / Teams, Growth and Enterprise are offered as Let’s Talk / Contact sales; no public paid list prices were isolated and are not listed. Developer Endpoint Protection is priced per endpoint per year, on request, with two official tiers (developer endpoints and standard endpoints).
